methodology_break_notice: Beginning in 2026 the Atlas replaced the previous binary RCA-presence input with a continuous specialization measure. Atlas snapshots may also revise historical values; comparisons must identify the source snapshot.
methodology_label: Atlas methodology current at snapshot retrieval
name: Economic Complexity Index

official_concept.summary_en: ECI measures productive knowledge expressed in the products an economy makes, combining export diversity with product ubiquity.
official_concept.summary_ru: ECI измеряет производственные знания, выраженные в выпускаемых экономикой товарах, сочетая разнообразие экспорта и редкость товаров.

ranking_eligibility_notice: Atlas Country Profiles and Rankings apply population, trade-volume, GDP/export-availability and reporting-quality criteria. GIR ranks only official ECI observations present in the selected stored snapshot and labels the rank as a GIR-derived analytical view.
